program.name: Balanced 25
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: Twenty-five minutes that cover the week: a superset, then an EMOM or a short flow.
program.about: A balanced week in twenty-five-minute sessions. Every day starts with a strength superset; one day follows it with a short EMOM of cardio moves, the next with a short yoga or mobility flow. Over a week that is strength every day, plus cardio and flexibility twice each. Abs finish the cardio days. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III adds reps.
